assy.translation:
n. 组件；装配
n. (Assy)人名；(法)阿西

assyria.definition: n. an ancient kingdom in northern Mesopotamia which is in present-day Iraq

assyrian.definition: n. an inhabitant of ancient Assyria
assyrian.translation:
a. 亚述的, 亚述人的, 亚述语的
n. 亚述人

assyrians.definition:
plural of Assyrian
n. an inhabitant of ancient Assyria
assyrians.translation:
(Assyrian 的复数) a. 亚述的, 亚述人的, 亚述语的
n. 亚述人

assyriological.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Assyriology; as, Assyriological
   studies.

assyriologist.definition:
n. One versed in Assyriology; a student of Assyrian
   archaeology.
assyriologist.translation: n. 亚述研究者, 亚述学家

assyriology.definition: n. archeology of the ancient Assyrians
assyriology.translation: n. 亚述研究, 亚述学
